extensionDescription.message: Checks what you write in the browser with your own LanguageTool server

serverUrlHelp.message: The LanguageTool server that checks your text, for example http://localhost:8010 or https://lt.example.com.

localServerHint.message: No server of your own? Run one on this computer with Podman or Docker (use docker in place of podman), then click "Use local server" and "Save and Test". Your text stays on this computer.

publicServerHint.message: Just trying it out? Use the public server of $ARG1$. It has usage limits, and your text goes to LanguageTool.

invalidServerUrl.message: Enter a URL that starts with https:// or http://.

serverPermissionDenied.message: Inkling needs access to $ARG1$ to send your text to the server. Allow it when the browser asks, then click "Save and Test" again. The setting was not saved.

checkingOffWithoutServer.message: Checking is off until you set a server.

defaultEnabledHelp.message: Can make some apps behave abnormally.

delayHelp.message: Wait this many milliseconds after typing stops before checking the text again.

delayError.message: Enter a whole number of milliseconds between 0 and 60000.

activationKeyHelp.message: Press this key twice to open the suggestion card of the mark nearest the cursor.

hotkeyHelp.message: Applies the first suggestion of the mark nearest the cursor. A mark without suggestions is ignored.

userDictionaryHelp.message: One word per line. These words are never marked as spelling mistakes.

exportDomainsHelp.message: Downloads a JSON list of the sites where checking is on.

couldNotExport.message: Could not export the enabled domains: $ARG1$

disabledRulesHelp.message: LanguageTool rule IDs, one per line. "Disable rule" in a suggestion adds its rule here.

ignoredSuggestionsHelp.message: Show all suggestions again that you ignored.

couldNotLoadSite.message: Could not load the state of this site: $ARG1$

languagesNeedServer.message: Inkling reads the available languages from the server. Save a server first.

couldNotLoadLanguages.message: Could not read the languages from the server: $ARG1$

languageVariantsHelp.message: The spelling the server uses when it detects one of these languages. Until you change one, Inkling takes them from the languages set in your browser.

preferredLanguagesHelp.message: The languages you write in. They help the server detect the language of short texts.

motherTongueHelp.message: Lets the server find mistakes that are typical for speakers of this language, such as false friends.

pickyHelp.message: Also report style issues and less certain mistakes.
